title: LegaSea on 30A | 4BR Seacrest Beach Rental | Royal Destinations
meta_description: LegaSea is a new 4BR Gulf view home in Seacrest Beach 30A with rooftop outdoor living and lagoon pool access. Sleeps 12. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: LegaSea on 30A by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 10 E Trigger Trail, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: Look no further for your dream getaway on 30A. LegaSea on 30A is a stunning luxury home located on the coveted east end, bordering Rosemary Beach and Scenic Highway 30A, making it an ideal choice among luxury 30A rentals. Designed across three thoughtfully planned levels, this residence features four bedrooms, four full bathrooms, and a bonus bunk sleeping area, offering both space and privacy for every guest. As one of the premier 30A luxury vacation rentals, LegaSea on 30A showcases the high-end finishes today’s travelers expect, including soaring ceilings, rich wood floors, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a dramatic wall of glass that fills the home with natural light. Each accommodation serves as a peaceful retreat, while the multiple living areas invite connection and relaxation throughout the home. The experience continues outdoors with a spectacular rooftop living and kitchen space, where guests can unwind in style while taking in views of the Gulf of Mexico. When it’s time for sun and fun, enjoy access to the Lagoon Resort Pool or hop on the shuttle to the sugar-white sands just minutes away. Perfectly positioned among the most desirable vacation rentals on 30A and a standout option for Seacrest Beach rentals, LegaSea on 30A offers an elevated escape where no detail has been overlooked. We truly look forward to hosting your stay and welcoming you to one of the finest 30A vacation rentals available! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -7-Minute Walk to Beach Access -Unobstructed Gulf Views -Access To Seacrest Community Lagoon Pool -Top Floor Outdoor Living and Entertainment Area -Beach Towels Provided During Stay -Bordering Scenic 30A in between Rosemary and Alys Beach -New Construction -Professional Décor -Outdoor Shower Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 1 Bunk Bonus Room / 1 Outdoor Shower First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath, Soaking Tub, Shower -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Shared Bath, Tub/Shower Combo -Bonus Sleeping: Twin/Twin Bunk Plus Twin Bed, Shared Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Attached Shared Bath, Shower -Open Floor Plan: Living Area, Dining Area, Gourmet Kitchen, Covered Balcony, Grill Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Attached Shared Bath, Soaking Tub, Shower, Twin Sleeper Sofa -Top Floor Outdoor Covered Gathering Space with Gulf Views and Outdoor Large TV Overlooking 30A -Top Floor Indoor Entertainment Kitchenette with Beverage Coolers and Sink -Desk Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Seasonal Beach Shuttle Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
